headwords: lấy dạ tiểu nhân đo lòng quân tử

flags.why: The gloss conflates runaway inflation with hyperinflation, which is called 'siêu lạm phát' ([VPBank](https://www.vpbank.com.vn/bi-kip-va-chia-se/corporate-story-and-tips/corporate-sat-category/lam-phat-la-gi)).

The example says runaway inflation, whereas 'hyperinflation' denotes the distinct category 'siêu lạm phát' ([VPBank](https://www.vpbank.com.vn/bi-kip-va-chia-se/corporate-story-and-tips/corporate-sat-category/lam-phat-la-gi)).
flags.fix: That country once went through a period of runaway inflation.
